proposal: The Mandate recommends that HHS apply TANF work requirements to any noncash benefit worth at least $50 a month received for six consecutive months (mirroring a 2019 SNAP rule's definition), clarify how states track and audit outcomes against the four statutory purposes in quarterly and annual reports, and require explicit measurement of marriage, healthy family formation and delaying sex to prevent pregnancy (p. 476).

status_summary: No rule or guidance matching the noncash benefit definition, the reporting clarification or the marriage and family formation measurement was found. ACF's TANF rulemaking in the period implements Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023 changes: a proposed rule published 2026-04-06 resets the caseload reduction credit base year and excludes small separate-state-program checks from work participation rates, and a 2026-07-31 final rule removes obsolete AFDC-era and TANF regulations. Neither was found to address the items in the recommendation.
title: Apply TANF work requirements to noncash benefits; measure marriage and family goals
uncertainties: The April 2026 proposed rule was read on federalregister.gov during review and confirmed not to address noncash benefits, the definition of assistance, reporting on the four TANF purposes, or marriage and family formation measures; it implements Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023 sections 301 and 303. The July 2026 final rule (effective 2026-09-29) was read in part; its Parts 260 to 265 discussion was cut off, but it states it is not intended to set new TANF requirements. The CRS report lists the Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023 as the most recent TANF law change, which suggests Public Law 119-21 made no TANF changes, but that law was not checked directly. Whether TANF reauthorization bills were introduced in the 119th Congress was not found; one web search returned only older items and congress.gov was not available. The Mandate text names CMS for the measurement item though TANF sits in ACF. Absence of evidence from a limited search, so confidence is capped. The related TANF record is c10-01.
